description:
General Information
NEW in the Original Packaging
Stocked & Shipped From – LEXINGTON, KY
What is This Part?
This is a Suzuki OEM pair of Tailgate Hinges.
Fixes Tailgate alignment due to sagging hinges
Make opening and closing easier.
Direct Replacement
What Will I Receive?
Qty 1 – Upper Hinge
Qty 1 – Lower Hinge
What Vehicle Will This Fit?
Suzuki Samurai 1985 – 1995 All Models
Suzuki SJ410 1980 – 1984 All Models
